description: The sole active execution ledger derived from .ralph/FRIDAY_DELIVERY_PLAN.md. All seven objectives are active workstreams and should progress concurrently where file ownership and integration safety permit. Voice is the first user-visible priority. One canonical Friday and one main product line only. This PRD does not define a competing architecture or roadmap. Acceptance requires real production-path evidence and, where specified, target-phone validation.

userStories.title: Deliver the first installable Friday seed
userStories.description: Advance Objective A of FRIDAY_DELIVERY_PLAN.md. Audit and complete one Android-owned production composition that installs and launches on the owner's phone, preserves one identity and experience, and remains usable offline within available resources. Do not treat a green emulator build as phone acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: A single Android APK builds from main and installs on the target phone; package identity, app name, icon and primary interface are correct.
A real typed interaction reaches the production path and returns an honest result; failures remain visible and recoverable.
Identity and durable experience survive process death, force-stop/restart and an app update; evidence identifies the exact device, build and test.
Offline operation is demonstrated on the target phone without Termux or a mandatory cloud/model dependency.
The production composition, actual gaps and evidence are documented; no duplicate Friday identity or competing production host remains.

The first seed has functional coverage for multiple-signal human interaction, working/long-term context, people/world context, uncertainty, multiple interpretations, prediction and learning; these are demonstrated outcomes, not permanent modules.
userStories.notes: Not yet accepted. Requires real-device evidence.

userStories.title: Make natural voice Friday's first complete interaction
userStories.description: Advance Objective B. Voice is the first user-visible priority, while other objectives continue in parallel. Inspect and reuse the current app voice stack; hearing and speaking providers remain replaceable affordances, not permanent cognitive organs.
acceptanceCriteria: Real microphone capture and speech recognition reach Friday's live production turn path; no demo-only or disconnected voice path is accepted.
Friday speaks audible responses on the target phone, listens again after speaking, supports interruption/barge-in, cancellation and conversation termination.
At least one offline hearing and speaking configuration works where supported; network loss does not create a different Friday.

Egyptian Arabic and mixed Arabic/English are evaluated using recorded representative samples; report word/error and latency evidence honestly and include the owner's direct listening evaluation of speech naturalness.
Provider selection is based on measured language quality, availability, latency, privacy and resource cost; failures do not fabricate transcripts or success.
userStories.notes: Not yet accepted. Voice has first visible priority.

userStories.title: Prove experience-driven developmental change
userStories.description: Advance Objective C. Build and test the causal experience → persistent internal change → changed later cognition/behaviour path on Friday's real production composition. Do not substitute transcript replay, profile fields or memory writes for development.
acceptanceCriteria: A repeatable Life Test drives an actual experience through the production composition and records the resulting internal change and later decision/behaviour.
The application/composition restarts between the experience and the later test; the original episode text is blocked from replay and retrieval.
A mechanism-off control removes the effect; the normal run retains it.
The later test is meaningfully different from the original episode and demonstrates generalization in observable behaviour, not merely a database write or self-report.
Provenance, uncertainty, test inputs, traces and evidence pack are retained; no fixed personality or developmental-stage blueprint is introduced.
Open-ended owner interaction remains the primary concept test; engineering Life Tests probe specific causal mechanisms and do not define Friday's personality or exhaustively define an individual.
userStories.notes: Not yet accepted. A real Life Test is required.

userStories.title: Connect universal perception, understanding and authorized action
userStories.description: Advance Objective D. Friday learns from relevant accessible inputs across domains and can turn plain-language outcomes into real actions through available affordances. Do not create separate specialist Fridays or a permanent brain per domain.
acceptanceCriteria: Relevant voice, text, visual context, device state, notification and sensor evidence can be used where access is available and authorized; provenance and uncertainty are retained.
An unfamiliar request can be mapped to available affordances without requiring a pre-labelled specialist category; ambiguity is preserved or clarified when material.
At least one useful set of phone actions executes through the production capability path and verifies postconditions rather than reporting that a command was merely sent.
A cross-domain Life Test demonstrates that evidence from one activity can influence a different later situation without replaying the original event.
Consequential or ambiguous actions respect owner authorization, Android permissions and protected operations.

When multiple signals are available, Friday can retain conflicting evidence and multiple plausible interpretations with uncertainty; no single sensor, facial expression, voice cue or text statement is automatically treated as truth.

Far-future glasses, vehicle and home integrations remain future horizons, not first-release blockers; the seed proves the general ability to use relevant accessible evidence and extend to new hosts later.
userStories.notes: Not yet accepted. Begin with the phone; preserve future glasses/vehicle/home extension.

userStories.title: Demonstrate liquid symbiosis and Nano Algorithm Environment
userStories.description: Advance Objective E. Measure the actual host and workload, then adapt the algorithms, models, runtime, precision, scheduling and local/cloud placement to reduce required-versus-available resource gaps while preserving output quality and continuity.
acceptanceCriteria: Target-phone measurements capture relevant memory, CPU/GPU/accelerator, thermal, battery, latency, throughput, model quality and workload interference; estimates are distinguished from measurements.
At least one adaptive decision changes a subsequent execution strategy based on measured host/workload conditions.
A controlled comparison shows resource/latency/energy changes and verifies that required task quality is not silently sacrificed.
Offline/online transitions preserve the same identity and durable experience; offline work continues within available resources and cloud remains optional expansion.
No accelerator, quantum hardware, performance gain or quality claim is made without direct evidence on the target hardware.
userStories.notes: Not yet accepted. The owner's liquid Symbiotic quantum software terminology remains authoritative; it does not imply assumed quantum hardware.

userStories.title: Give Friday a safe path to acquire and create capabilities
userStories.description: Advance Objective F. The Builder is a capability Friday can use and progressively direct, not a separate intelligence or permanent superior authority. The long-term path includes native source-level self-development, not only a restricted runtime DSL.
acceptanceCriteria: A real task exposes a missing capability and Friday identifies the gap from observed evidence.
Friday can research existing work, reverse-engineer useful mechanisms, combine/repurpose methods or construct a candidate without assuming precedent is required.
Candidate creation occurs in an isolated environment and is tested against the same objective as the current implementation by an independent verifier.
Required owner approval, Android permission boundaries, signing/provenance and rollback are enforced before executable promotion.
An approved capability becomes usable in Friday's actual production path, survives restart as applicable, and its observed outcome informs later development.
External AI providers, Ralph, OpenHands, GitHub Actions and coding workers remain replaceable resources; none owns Friday or solely certifies its own change.

The owner can state an intended outcome or direction in ordinary language; after authentication and required authorization, Friday determines the implementation without requiring the owner to design her internal architecture.
Friday can identify and diagnose a shortcoming in her own behaviour or capability, propose a repair, verify it independently, explain what changed and retain rollback evidence.
userStories.notes: Not yet accepted. Distinguish runtime capability construction from native source-level self-development.

userStories.title: Make development, updates and recovery continuous
userStories.description: Advance Objective G. Failures are diagnosed at root cause, interrupted work is resumable, and the installed app can receive verified updates without losing Friday's continuity.
acceptanceCriteria: Representative failure classes are reproduced, traced to originating causes and prevented by regression tests rather than patched at one symptom.
Interrupted build/research/construction tasks resume from durable checkpoints without duplicate actions, corrupted state or silent loss.
A production-signed APK and signing lineage are verified; update installation preserves package identity and Friday's durable state.
A failed update or candidate promotion rolls back to a last-known-good state and the app recovers its identity and experience.
A release artifact is downloadable and physically installable on the owner's phone; device evidence is recorded separately from CI and emulator evidence.
userStories.notes: Not yet accepted. Release and physical-phone evidence required.
